title: Web traffic deep dive
description: Sessions, signups and conversion by channel from data/web_traffic.csv

queries.totals: SELECT SUM(sessions) AS sessions, SUM(signups) AS signups, SUM(signups) * 1.0 / SUM(sessions) AS conversion FROM web_traffic
queries.weekly_sessions: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('week', date) AS VARCHAR) AS week, channel, SUM(sessions) AS sessions FROM web_traffic GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
queries.channel_share: SELECT channel, SUM(sessions) AS sessions, SUM(sessions) * 1.0 / SUM(SUM(sessions)) OVER () AS share FROM web_traffic GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
queries.weekly_conversion: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('week', date) AS VARCHAR) AS week, channel, SUM(signups) * 1.0 / SUM(sessions) AS conversion FROM web_traffic GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
queries.best_worst_day: WITH d AS (SELECT date, SUM(signups) AS signups FROM web_traffic GROUP BY 1) SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'Best day' AS label, CAST(date AS VARCHAR) AS day, signups FROM d ORDER BY signups DESC, date LIMIT 1) UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'Worst day' AS label, CAST(date AS VARCHAR) AS day, signups FROM d ORDER BY signups ASC, date LIMIT 1)
